historical_record.description: Completed as the Data Mart, a three-storey steel-framed office building clad in glass block, on the triangular parcel beside the freeway interchange.

historic_survey.survey: Modern & Postmodern Architectural Styles Historic Context Statement (2024)
historic_survey.note: The California DataMart, later the Diamond and Jewelry Mart, by Tanner & VanDine - the firm that became Tanner Leddy Maytum Stacy. Shown in SFMOMA's 1991 'In the Spirit of Modernism' exhibition and named as one of the projects that signalled the local shift from Postmodernism to New Modernism. It took a Progressive Architecture award in 1984.
